family.name: Moor wolves
family.lore: When the shepherds left the Moor the wolves kept the flocks. Then there were no flocks.

monsters.name: Moor Wolf
monsters.desc: Lean and grey along the back, with the patience of an animal that eats once a week.
monsters.answer: Keep your back to a wall so only one can reach you at a time.

monsters.name: Greymuzzle
monsters.desc: An old she-wolf with a torn ear. The pack runs when she sings, and scatters when she stops.
monsters.answer: Stun her mid-howl, or bring her down first: her wolves lose heart when she falls.
